categories.main_business_segments: Seowon Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the non-ferrous metals manufacturing sector, specializing in copper alloys such as brass billets, ingots, and other copper alloy products. These products serve diverse industries including automotive parts, industrial machinery, electrical and electronic components, shipbuilding, fire-fighting equipment, and construction. The company also engages in recycling and processing of scrap metals and related materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes electric induction furnaces and gas melting furnaces for melting and casting copper alloys, supported by continuous casting and ball mill equipment. It employs advanced alloy development technologies, including patented methods for lead-free, corrosion-resistant, and machinable brass and bronze alloys. Research and development focus on improving casting processes, alloy compositions, and recycling technologies, including fluidized bed reduction and dry smelting for resource recovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Seowon's primary customers include manufacturers in automotive, electrical, electronic, semiconductor, construction, and household goods sectors. Major clients include large corporations such as JOMOO Group and Xiamen Hailin Supply Chain. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports accounting for approximately 55% of sales and domestic sales 45%.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with production facilities in Ansan and Hwaseong. It sources raw materials domestically and internationally, with about 72% of raw materials procured domestically and 28% imported. Its sales cover both domestic and overseas markets, with significant export activities to Asia and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Seowon operates primarily in the midstream segment of the non-ferrous metals supply chain, focusing on the melting, casting, and processing of copper alloys into billets and ingots. It procures raw materials such as brass and copper scrap and zinc, processes them into semi-finished products, and sells directly to manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in developing environmentally friendly, lead-free, and corrosion-resistant copper alloys, enhancing casting and melting technologies, and recycling low-grade copper and alloy by-products. It engages in joint research with academic and external institutions to innovate new materials and improve production efficiency. Future R&D also targets waste heat recovery systems and energy-saving technologies to enhance sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Seowon generates revenue primarily through direct sales of copper alloy products including billets and ingots, as well as processing fees for toll manufacturing. Sales are conducted directly to customers without intermediaries, covering both domestic and export markets. The company also earns revenue from scrap metal trading and related services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Seowon is positioned as a mid-sized leading player in the Korean copper alloy processing industry, alongside competitors such as Poongsan Corporation and Daechang Co., Ltd. It holds approximately 30% domestic market share in copper alloy ingots and billets. The company benefits from strong quality leadership, especially in KS-certified products for plumbing and fire-fighting valves, but faces competition from integrated producers and imported products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Seowon reported total assets of approximately KRW 247 billion and annual sales of KRW 233 billion, reflecting a 15% decline in sales compared to the previous year. The company experienced a net loss of KRW 10.16 billion in 2023, reversing from profitability in 2022, mainly due to increased financial expenses and investment losses. Despite short-term challenges, it maintains a stable capital structure with a debt ratio near 99% and continues investing in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Seowon emphasizes high-quality, specialized copper alloy products with superior corrosion resistance, machinability, and environmental compliance such as lead-free alloys. Its competitive edge lies in proprietary alloy technologies, stable raw material procurement, and direct customer relationships ensuring tailored quality control. The company also leverages its R&D capabilities and patented technologies to meet evolving industry demands and regulatory standards.
